s: Union Minister for Railways and Commerce Piyush Goyal has announced that the entire network of railways in the country will run on electricity by ____.
x:
the announced deadline passed – now about 99.2% of the broad-gauge network is electrified, full electrification and net-zero targeted by 2030 (Ministry of Railways / Gulf News 2026)
